spans.note: section banner: data loading and preparation

spans.operation: read the player-referee dyad CSV as the raw dataset for the whole analysis

spans.note: prints raw row count after loading

spans.operation: average rater1 and rater2 into a single continuous skinTone score

spans.note: computes and prints inter-rater correlation as a diagnostic

spans.operation: threshold skinTone at 0.5 to create a binary darkSkin indicator, leaving missing skinTone as NaN
reduce redCards to a binary anyRedCard flag instead of using the count
log-transform games to build the log_games covariate
bucket the free-text position field into Goalkeeper/Defender/Midfielder/Forward/Other/Missing categories
drop dyads with missing darkSkin or missing referee meanIAT to form the analysis sample

spans.note: prints sample-size and composition summary of analysis_final
computes and prints unadjusted red-card rate for each skin-tone group

spans.operation: compute the raw (unadjusted) gap in red-card rate between dark- and light-skin groups as a percentage-point difference

spans.note: prints the unadjusted difference computed just above

spans.operation: define and fit the adjustment set for the outcome model — logit of anyRedCard on darkSkin, log_games, league, position category and referee meanIAT, with standard errors clustered by player

spans.note: prints the model formula and SE method
pulls coefficient, SE, CI and p-value off the fitted model object

spans.operation: exponentiate the darkSkin coefficient and its CI to report an odds ratio
standardize over the sample by scoring every dyad twice (forcing darkSkin to 1, then to 0) and differencing the average predicted probabilities to get the adjusted risk difference

spans.note: prints adjusted probabilities and risk difference

spans.operation: cluster-bootstrap the risk difference by resampling players with replacement, refitting an unclustered logit and recomputing the risk difference on each of 500 resamples, silently dropping resamples where the fit fails to converge

spans.note: announces the bootstrap run and its size
prints bootstrap sample count, mean and SD

spans.operation: take the 2.5/97.5 percentiles of the bootstrap distribution as the 95% CI for the risk difference
convert the point estimate and bootstrap SD into a z-statistic and read off a normal-theory two-sided p-value instead of using the bootstrap distribution's own percentiles

spans.note: prints final primary-estimand results banner and values
builds and saves the two-panel figure (bootstrap histogram and rate bar chart)
prints recap of primary estimand, secondary estimand, and model details

spans.operation: declare the hypothesis supported, not supported, or inconclusive depending on whether the bootstrap CI for the risk difference excludes zero
